title:
Epic to handle the various actions when pressing continue on the BulkRetrainModelsModal:
- If `AdjustTimeWindow` is selected:
  Open the confirmation modal.
- If `AdjustModelConfig` is selected:
  Update {@link ModelConfigApplicationState} with the dataset, template, and pipeline hyperparams of the selected model.
  Redirect to the selected asset's detailed model config page.
- If `CopyConfigToNewAsset` is selected:
  Update {@link ModelConfigApplicationState} with the template, and pipeline hyperparams of the selected model.
  Update {@link ModelConfigApplicationState} with the newly selected asset's dataset.
  Redirect to the newly selected asset's detailed model config page.
name: RetrainModalContinueActionsEpic
